Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.es: No pongas una dirección IP ni un servidor DHCP en {iface} para los clientes; PPPoE funciona en la capa 2 y las sesiones obtienen sus direcciones del pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.pt-BR: Não coloque endereço IP nem servidor DHCP em {iface} para os clientes; o PPPoE funciona na camada 2 e as sessões recebem endereços do pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.fr: Ne mettez ni adresse IP ni serveur DHCP sur {iface} pour les clients ; PPPoE fonctionne au niveau 2 et les sessions reçoivent leurs adresses du pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.de: Legen Sie auf {iface} für Kunden keine IP-Adresse und keinen DHCP-Server an; PPPoE läuft auf Layer 2, und Sitzungen erhalten ihre Adressen aus dem Pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.id: Jangan beri alamat IP atau DHCP server pada {iface} untuk pelanggan; PPPoE berjalan di layer 2 dan sesi mendapat alamat dari pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.it: Non assegnare un indirizzo IP né un server DHCP a {iface} per i clienti; PPPoE funziona a livello 2 e le sessioni ricevono gli indirizzi dal pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.tr: Müşteriler için {iface} üzerine IP adresi veya DHCP sunucusu koymayın; PPPoE 2. katmanda çalışır ve oturumlar adreslerini havuzdan alır.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.vi: Đừng đặt địa chỉ IP hay máy chủ DHCP trên {iface} cho khách hàng; PPPoE chạy ở lớp 2 và các phiên nhận địa chỉ từ pool.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.ru: Не назначайте на {iface} IP-адрес или DHCP-сервер для клиентов: PPPoE работает на втором уровне, а сессии получают адреса из пула.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.pl: Nie przypisuj na {iface} adresu IP ani serwera DHCP dla klientów; PPPoE działa w warstwie 2, a sesje dostają adresy z puli.
Don't put an IP address or a DHCP server.hi: ग्राहकों के लिए {iface} पर IP एड्रेस या DHCP सर्वर न लगाएँ; PPPoE लेयर 2 पर चलता है और सेशन को पते पूल से मिलते हैं।

FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.es: El tráfico con fasttrack se salta las queues dinámicas que crean los perfiles. Desactiva FastTrack para el tráfico de los clientes, o los planes de velocidad no se aplicarán.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.pt-BR: O tráfego com fasttrack pula as queues dinâmicas criadas pelos profiles. Desligue o FastTrack para o tráfego dos clientes, ou os planos de velocidade não serão aplicados.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.fr: Le trafic en fasttrack contourne les queues dynamiques créées par les profils. Désactivez FastTrack pour le trafic des clients, sinon les forfaits de débit ne s'appliqueront pas.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.de: FastTrack-Verkehr überspringt die dynamischen Queues, die die Profile erzeugen. Schalten Sie FastTrack für Kundenverkehr aus, sonst greifen die Tarife nicht.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.id: Lalu lintas yang di-fasttrack melewati queue dinamis yang dibuat profile. Matikan FastTrack untuk lalu lintas pelanggan, atau paket kecepatan tidak akan berlaku.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.it: Il traffico in FastTrack salta le code dinamiche create dai profili. Disattiva FastTrack per il traffico dei clienti, altrimenti i piani di velocità non verranno applicati.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.tr: FastTrack trafiği, profillerin oluşturduğu dinamik kuyrukları atlar. Müşteri trafiği için FastTrack'i kapatın, yoksa hız planları uygulanmaz.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.vi: Lưu lượng FastTrack bỏ qua các hàng đợi động do profile tạo ra. Hãy tắt FastTrack cho lưu lượng của khách hàng, nếu không các gói tốc độ sẽ không có hiệu lực.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.ru: Трафик FastTrack обходит динамические очереди, создаваемые профилями. Отключите FastTrack для клиентского трафика, иначе тарифы скорости не будут применяться.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.pl: Ruch objęty FastTrack omija dynamiczne kolejki tworzone przez profile. Wyłącz FastTrack dla ruchu klientów, bo inaczej plany prędkości nie będą działać.
FastTracked traffic skips the dynamic qu.hi: FastTrack किया गया ट्रैफ़िक प्रोफ़ाइल से बनने वाली डायनामिक queues को छोड़ देता है। ग्राहक ट्रैफ़िक के लिए FastTrack बंद करें, वरना स्पीड प्लान लागू नहीं होंगे।
